text:
maria: quick follow-up from the quant-profile RFC
we need a clear versioning strategy and safe override semantics for per-customer profiles. proposing immutable versions + allowlist-based overrides + canary gating.

devin: +1. important: self-serve overrides should be limited to runtime knobs (batching, latency cap). layer/scale overrides must be blocked unless managed.

omkar: note from runtime: profile_id must be a checksum that invalidates compilation caches. if an override requires kernel changes we should force recompile and reject in self-serve.

jason: ops: propose canary progression 0.5% -> 5% -> 25% with auto-revert if metric delta exceeds threshold. need to decide metrics per endpoint (f1, exact-match, perplexity).

carly: product: customers ask for per-tenant control. suggest two modes: managed (Redwood vets + deploys) and self-serve (customer accepts narrower surface).

maria: sketch schema (as text, not full JSON): name, version, profile_id(sha256), base_profile_ref, allowed_overrides[], quality_gate(metric + threshold), canary_defaults(fraction, duration). also canary_probe_prompts list.

omkar: runtime constraint: disallow per-layer quant param overrides in self-serve. those require managed approval and recompilation.

devin: fallback/rollback: when canary fails route traffic to fallback profile (e.g., int8) and emit circuit-breaker event with profile_id + override_source + error_code.

jason: action items: draft canary thresholds + alert playbook; add automation for auto-revert at 5% step.

maria: i'll open the profile-schema PR with allowed_overrides whitelist and immutability rules, and add telemetry tags for profile_id and override_source.

carly: i'll surface guidance for customers on choosing probe prompts and acceptable degradation budgets.

canary-bot: Pipeline queued: profile-canary/fp8-customer-v1 126 will run once schema PR merges and CI passes.
